verdict.rationale: Anrok's pricing page claims 'Registration handled in every jurisdiction' and 'Filing and payments, done for you,' plus a dashboard screenshot showing 'automatic registration completion in 13 jurisdictions,' indicating registration filing is a marketed capability. However, there is no evidence of per-registration transparent pricing or a status-tracking UI/API for individual registrations — only high-level marketing claims without documented workflow, cost breakdown, or tracking detail. Missing for 10: per-registration pricing transparency, detailed status-tracking documentation/UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation that filings are actually completed by the vendor.
